name: Feralas
_terrain: A 3.3.5 zone Turtle reworked in its east: Thalanaar's new camp, Chimaera Roost Vale and the Feralkin Cave, with their NPCs and quests. The 3.3.5 zone, its NPCs and quests stay; Turtle's additions are merged in.
_exclude_creatures: Turtle systems: the rented Riding Gryphon and Beaky (npc_flying_mount: Turtle's free-flight rental), Dinka Dinker (serves only members of the player guild 'Traveler', guild id 172, with a slow-fall cast).
_exclude_gameobjects: Gardening Zone Check (Turtle gardening); Gemstone Deposit (Turtle Jewelcrafting gem node, used by Jarkal Mossmeld's quests, left out with Badlands).
_extra_spawns: The Ancient Guardian in Durotar by the Southfury River (its drop, the Essence of Zalmos, finishes Cenerron's 'Essence of Zalmos'); Turtle's Bramblehide Rootshapers and Gnarled Bramblehides in Razorfen Kraul (they drop the Gnarled Brambleroot for Calaran Windseeker's 'The Gnarled Bramblehide').
_extra_creature_templates: Quest credits of The Way of the Spiritwolf III-V (given by manual/067).
